updates.request: Collect deterministic RX/TX SoundWire identity tuple for both WCD9378 endpoints, including modalias and numeric fields.
updates.why_needed: WCD938x confirms the LE SDW matching model but not WCD9378 values; both endpoints must be proven, not inferred.
updates.exact_command_or_log: journalctl -b -k > dmesg_boot.log; for d in /sys/bus/soundwire/devices/*; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; echo "## $d"; for f in modalias mfg_id manf_id part_id class_id version_id dev_num unique_id; do [ -f "$d/$f" ] && echo "$f=$(cat $d/$f)"; done; done > sysfs_soundwire_snapshot.txt
updates.acceptance_criteria: Both RX and TX nodes expose stable tuple fields sufficient to defend final `SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY(...)` and modalias mapping.

updates.request: Capture explicit mapping evidence from runtime tuple to DT compatible naming used on target board.
updates.why_needed: Prevents LA-style string guessing and keeps LE binding decisions evidence-backed.
updates.acceptance_criteria: Runtime modalias plus DTS patch provide a deterministic compatible derivation path.

updates.request: Trace paged register traffic above 0xffff and correlate with active codec operations.
updates.why_needed: WCD938x learning shows regcache lifecycle reuse but cannot prove WCD9378 paging requirement.
updates.exact_command_or_log: echo function > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/current_tracer; echo sdw_fill_msg > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/set_ftrace_filter; echo qcom_swrm_xfer_msg >> /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/set_ftrace_filter; echo 1 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on; # run playback/capture; echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on; cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/trace > trace_sdw_paging.log
updates.acceptance_criteria: Trace demonstrates paged-access path usage during WCD9378 activity with success/failure outcomes visible.

updates.request: Add regcache transition proof around suspend/resume and SDW attach lifecycle.
updates.why_needed: WCD938x LE pattern relies on cache-only and cache-sync transitions; confirm same assumptions hold for WCD9378 runtime.
updates.exact_command_or_log: capture dmesg with dynamic debug for regmap/sdw around runtime suspend/resume and codec attach; include timestamps in dmesg_runtime.log
updates.acceptance_criteria: Logs show ordered cache-only/cache-sync transitions without unexpected I/O failures.

updates.request: Collect controller-side error/no-error evidence while paged transactions are exercised.
updates.why_needed: Determines whether Qualcomm SoundWire controller patch is truly required or should remain fail-closed.
updates.acceptance_criteria: Either clear absence of controller failures or reproducible failure signature with replay steps.

updates.request: Capture Class-H/HPH/flyback register transitions during headset enable and disable.
updates.why_needed: WCD938x confirms shared Class-H style but WCD9378 enum/base choice remains runtime-gated.
updates.exact_command_or_log: amixer -c <card> contents > amixer_before.txt; # enable HPH + playback; cat /sys/kernel/debug/regmap/<wcd9378>/registers > regmap_before_after/registers_after_enable.txt; # disable path; cat /sys/kernel/debug/regmap/<wcd9378>/registers > regmap_before_after/registers_after_disable.txt
updates.acceptance_criteria: Register deltas clearly map to Class-H and HPH transitions and support final enum/base decision.

updates.request: Record playback and AMIC1 capture with full control snapshots and dmesg timeline.
updates.why_needed: WCD938x topology lessons should not be applied to WCD9378 unless actual paths are proven on board.
updates.exact_command_or_log: amixer -c <card> contents > amixer_before.txt; aplay -D <playback_dev> -r 48000 -c 2 -f S16_LE <known.wav> > playback.log 2>&1; arecord -D <capture_dev> -r 48000 -c 1 -f S16_LE -d 10 amic1.wav > capture.log 2>&1; amixer -c <card> contents > amixer_after.txt; journalctl -k > dmesg_runtime.log
updates.acceptance_criteria: Replayable command set with deterministic pass/fail and complete pre/post state capture.

updates.request: Provide full board DTS/DTSI patch with RX/TX nodes, port mapping, reset, supplies, and DAI links.
updates.why_needed: LE DT normalization from WCD938x is only safe if board-level wiring is known and separated from generic driver needs.
updates.exact_command_or_log: git diff -- '*.dts' '*.dtsi' > board_dts.patch; include pinctrl snippets and referenced include files
updates.acceptance_criteria: Patch is replayable, complete, and clearly distinguishes board-only values from generic LE binding properties.

updates.request: Capture bind ordering and device-link lifecycle logs for aggregate codec and SDW children.
updates.why_needed: WCD938x LE split relies on strict bind/unbind ordering; confirms A.1 lifecycle assumptions on board.
updates.exact_command_or_log: dmesg with driver core and SoundWire logs during probe/remove cycles; include repeated module unload/reload if available
updates.acceptance_criteria: Logs show stable child-before-parent availability and clean teardown without orphan links.

updates.request: Add mute issue reproduction matrix with explicit pass/fail/intermittent classification.
updates.why_needed: Prevents unsafe workaround insertion and aligns with LE anti-hack lesson from WCD938x.
updates.exact_command_or_log: runtime_playback_capture_report.md must include sequence, frequency, expected vs observed behavior, and supporting dmesg/regmap snippets
updates.acceptance_criteria: Issue state is reproducible and decisionable as APPLY/REJECT/KEEP_FAIL_CLOSED for workaround proposals.
